displaced_geometry.label: I-geometry ehambile
displaced_geometry.measures: Imigqa lapho i-centroid yayo iwa ngaphandle kwesisekelo sayo, futhi ehlanganisa leso sisekelo ngaphansi kwengxenye yeside sayo.
displaced_geometry.reading: Yibone njengomsindo wesizinda ngaphandle kokuba indawo yegunya ethile ingasebenzi kahle. Ukuskena kukhombisa isilinganiso esiphezulu kulelo hlolo, ngakho inamba iyisilinganiso esiphezulu hhayi isibalo — ifundwe njenge "okukungele lokhu".
displaced_geometry.remedy: Yibuyisele esisekelweni lapho umugqa othile ungashayi kahle; kungenjalo iyishiye njengoba injalo.
displaced_geometry.why: Umugqa ohleli ngaphandle kwesisekelo sakhe uvamise ukusho ukuthi umthombo udwebe imingcele emibili ngokwemigwaqo eyahlukene noma izikhathi ezehlukile. Ukungabi nasisekelo okungashayi kahle kuvela lapha futhi, kodwa ezingeni lomhlaba okuningi kungumsindo we-geographic.
dual_coverage.label: Ukugubuzelwa kabili
dual_coverage.measures: Izwe lapho iphuzu lalo elimele ligubuzelwa futhi ngumunye umhlaba.
dual_coverage.reading: Kwenziwe ukuze kunikeze ulwazi. Isibalo esingeyona i-zero yimo eyilindelekile emhlabeni, hhayi inkinga okumele ikhishwe.
dual_coverage.remedy: Yamukela isiboniso; susa uhlangothi kuphela lapho kunesinqumo esiqondile ngokuthi yiliphi ithelwa leli thuba elivumeleka.
dual_coverage.why: Izizwe ezimbili zifuna indawo eyodwa. Idatha ibhala zombili ngoba impikiswano iyinyani, futhi inkundla yakhelwe ukuthi zombili zihlale ndawonye endaweni eyodwa yomdlalo kunokukhetha onqobayo.
mis_anchored_cluster.label: Ama-cluster angashaywanga kahle
mis_anchored_cluster.measures: Isisekelo esiphethe abantwana abathathu noma ngaphezulu lapho ngamunye wabo ehleli phezu kwakho ngokuphelele — ukuhlanganiswa okungaphansi kwe-5%.
mis_anchored_cluster.reading: Kuncane futhi kuyazinzile. Eminye imingcele iyinyani: ama-archipelago nezindawo zasemazulwini, ezibhalwe ngokwethembeka.
mis_anchored_cluster.remedy: Dala isisekelo lapho iqulu lifanele ukuba nesisekelo salo; yamukela lapho ukuhlelwa kuyikho okuyinyani.
mis_anchored_cluster.why: Lokhu kuyifomu eqondene ye-geometry ehambile: hhayi umugqa owodwa odlule kodwa isethi ephelele ebophelwe endaweni engashayi kahle. Empeleni kuvela kakhulu ifuthe lezinhlelo zokuphatha zasemakholoni — iminyango yasemazulwini namaqulu ama-island aphathwa isisekelo sasekhaya.
national_delta_gt5.label: Umehluko wokuhlukaniswa
national_delta_gt5.measures: Isisekelo lapho abantu baso behlukile kunensumisa yabantwana baso ngaphezu kwe-5%.
national_delta_gt5.reading: Umlando wezempilo zemephu, hhayi uhlu lwezimpazamo. Bekubalulekile ekuhlolaneni izinkinga zokudweba isifunda; nsuku zonke, buka ukuthi kuyakhula yini.
national_delta_gt5.remedy: Akukho okuzenzakalayo — kukhomba ukuthi iyiphi ingxenye okumele ibukwe.
national_delta_gt5.why: Izinga ngalinye lihlukaniswa ngokuzimela kusuka ku-raster, ngakho isisekelo nabantwana kumele bafike ensumisa efanayo cishe. Igebe lisho ukuthi ingxenye yomntwana igubuzela yona ngokwayo noma ishiya izikhala mayelana nesisekelo — ukuguquka okuvela ngokuhamba kwesikhathi njengoba kube nokungalingani kwabantu besifunda.
nature.informational.hint: Isibalo okumele sibukwe, hhayi impazamo okumele isuswe.
nature.structural.hint: Isihlahla ngokwaso asilungile — thatha isinyathelo kuleli.
orphaned_rows.label: Imigqa engenazo izisekelo
orphaned_rows.measures: Izindawo zegunya eziphilayo ezingenasisekelo esiphilayo — noma azinasisekelo nhlobo, noma isisekelo esisusiwe.
orphaned_rows.reading: Lindela i-zero. Isibalo sanoma yikuphi esingeyona i-zero sifanele ukuthathwa isinyathelo, futhi isibalo sinciphisa iqiniso: isisekelo esihlukene sithatha wonke isihlahla saso.
orphaned_rows.remedy: Susa isisekelo — nakuba impendulo efanele kwesinye isikhathi ukuthi umugqa ungaphansi kwesigaba esiphezulu futhi kufanele abe u-L1 wakhe.
orphaned_rows.why: Noma yini ehamba esihlahleni kusuka emhlabeni — ukuhlukanisa izifunda, ukwabelana, ukuqoqwa kwabantu — ayikwazi ukubona umugqa ohlukene. Lokhu kuwukuhlola okukodwa lapha okuchaza impazamo kunokuba kube yimimo yomhlaba.
raster_coverage.label: Ukugubuzelwa kwe-raster
raster_coverage.measures: Izwe ezingenazo nhlobo ama-raster tiles abantu, noma anama-tiles kodwa abantu abagcinwe bangaphansi kwengxenye yalawo ama-raster abambe kuleyo ndawo.
raster_coverage.reading: Umlando ngamunye uyigebe langempela elifanele ukwazi ngalo. "No tiles" kuyingxenye yokukhawulelwa komthombo wabantu, hhayi into okuzoyilungisa ukuskena kabusha.
raster_coverage.remedy: Phinda ubala abantu lapho kukhona ama-tiles; yamukela lapho umthombo engenalo nhlobo ukugubuzelwa.
raster_coverage.why: Abantu bayikho okungena emthethweni wesihlalo — usayizi wekamra uyisiqu root sabo. Izwe i-raster engaligubuzeli ngeke lisinziwe, nelibalele kakhulu kuneraster yalo ngeke limelele ngokwanele.
same_space_chain.label: Amakhala asendaweni eyodwa
same_space_chain.measures: Isisekelo lapho umntwana wayo oyedwa egubuzela indawo efanayo — i-geometry efanayo ncamashi, noma izindawo ezisusa 2% omunye nomunye ngokuhambelana. Amapheya alandelanayo akha amakhala.
same_space_chain.reading: Kugxilile ngokwezwe kunokuba kusabalale ngokulinganayo — ihhovisi lezibalo zezwe lihlukanisa leyo ngxenye noma alikwenzi. Izibalo ezinkulu ezweni elilodwa ziyisici salowo mthombo, hhayi ukulimala.
same_space_chain.remedy: Hlanganisa ikhala: umugqa ophezulu ugcina isikhundla sendawo yegunya engadlali futhi uthatha abantwana bomkume wakhe ophansi.
same_space_chain.why: Ukukhishwa kwemithombo kubhalile indawo eyodwa kabili ezingeni lezokuphatha elilimbili. Imigqa emibili imele indawo eyodwa, ngakho omunye kuwo uyisixhumanisi nje hhayi indawo ehlukile yokuphetha.
stray_synthetic.label: Izinto zokwakha ezingafanele
stray_synthetic.measures: Imigqa yezwe okuyizindawo zokwakha nakuba iqulu ledatha lomthombo linomhlahlandlela we-ADM0 weqiniso walelo zwe.
stray_synthetic.reading: Kulindeleke kube nguzero. Noma yikuphi okubhalwe kufanele kuthathwe isinyathelo ngokushesha — umugqa okubalwa wona umele idatha yangempela ekhona kudisiki.
stray_synthetic.remedy: Phinda ungene ngemingcele egxile kulelo zwe: umgenisi uthuthukisa indawo yokwakha ngokuphatha i-geometry ethunyelwe, bese ukubuyisela kwemibhalo kubuyisela abantu abahlala lapho.
stray_synthetic.why: Izwe lokwakha linama-geometry nabantu abatholwe ngokubala esikhundleni sezinto ezengeziwe — konke okuhlanganiswe, isibalo sezihlalo nemaphephu angaphezulu kwayo kufunda iphutha. Umgenisi udala umugqa wezwe kuphela lapho iqulu ledatha lingathumele lutho (Puerto Rico); ukuba khona kwalo lapho kufanele kube khona ifayela kusho ukuthi ukugijima kokungenisa kuthathile indawo yedatha yangempela, iphutha elitholwe ekuhlolweni kwe-Philippines.
